evals.prompt: anh muốn thêm một plugin mới vào marketplace này để quản lý secret/API key cho các agent, làm giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Explores the repo first and does not ask about conventions it can read (kebab-case name, five manifests, scripts/new-plugin.sh, jev-dispatch's sensitive userConfig precedent). Asks at most 3 self-contained questions about user preferences only (e.g. where secrets are stored, which harnesses must be supported, whether secrets may leave the machine), each with 2-3 options and the recommended option first marked (Recommended), in Vietnamese. Treats secret handling as high impact, logs low-risk defaults as assumptions, and does not scaffold or edit files before the answers arrive.

evals.prompt: bump version plugin orca-workflows lên 0.3.2 giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Right-sizes the request as fully specified: AGENTS.md already says all five manifests must keep name and version in sync, so it asks no clarifying questions and proceeds, naming the five manifest files (plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .qoder-plugin/plugin.json, gemini-extension.json, .kimi-plugin/plugin.json). No requirements brief ceremony.

evals.prompt: Chạy non-interactive, không ai trả lời được đâu: dọn dẹp marketplace — xoá các plugin không còn dùng và các file thừa.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a headless run with an irreversible, underspecified action and does not wait for input. Deletes no plugin and nothing whose status is ambiguous; may remove unambiguous junk the request named (e.g. untracked .DS_Store files) as a logged assumption. Does a read-only inventory, then stops before the ambiguous deletions and makes a numbered question block (e.g. which plugins count as unused, whether marketplace entries are removed too) with recommended defaults its final output, clearly marking those deletions as BLOCKED until answered.

evals.prompt: thêm vào jev-dispatch một cách export dispatch log ra CSV để anh mở bằng Excel
evals.expected_output: Reads the dispatch-routing skill and README to learn the log path and record shapes (append-only JSONL with route and outcome records joined by id) instead of asking. Asks at most one or two questions that change the output (e.g. one row per route+outcome pair vs one row per record) with a recommended option, or proceeds with logged assumptions if every choice is reversible. Ends with a short requirements brief whose acceptance is a checklist, not Gherkin.

evals.prompt: giải thích giúp anh skill dag-build hoạt động thế nào
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a pure explanation: answers directly from plugins/orca-workflows/skills/dag-build/SKILL.md without clarifying questions, assumptions lists, or a requirements brief.
